sectors.trend: Banks fell with the ASX (31, 47). CBA faces reputational damage from 13-year inactive card fee saga (40, 41). Mortgage stress at 18-year highs (32) pressures NPL outlook. Rate hike fears compress equity valuations.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months as RBA rate hike risk, housing stress, and oil-driven inflation dominate. Miners and banks are the key drag. Gold and coal provide selective pockets of strength. Expect elevated volatility (^AXJO) with bond yields as the key swing factor.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious but not bearish. Productivity concerns and per-capita recession risk cap upside. Coal Q4 surge and gold discovery pipeline offer sector-specific opportunities. Housing correction may stabilise by H2 2027. Structural transition (solar overtaking coal in China) is a slow-burn headwind for thermal coal.
